description: OAuth security for the SAP CPI MCP server

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.mcp.read
scopes.description: Read MPLs, packages, flows, deployed artifacts, security material, etc.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.mcp.delete
scopes.description: Delete/undeploy tools, plus the generic cpi_write / cpi_invoke_function escape hatches

role-templates.name: Support
role-templates.description: Read-only: monitoring, MPL search, package/flow inspection

role-templates.name: Architect
role-templates.description: Full access, including delete/undeploy and the generic escape-hatch tools
